items.title: 新瓶旧酒or涅槃重生？操作系统的 AI 进化终将走向何方？
items.raw_excerpt: 过去一年，AI 技术已从概念热潮深度渗透至产业肌理，成为驱动 IT 基础设施重构的核心引擎。当大模型、异构算力、智能体（Agent）等技术要素持续冲击传统技术体系，操作系统作为软硬件协同的核心枢纽，其 AI 进化的本质也引发了行业的深刻思考：OS 的 AI 进化，究竟是换汤不换药的 “新瓶旧酒”，还是颠覆底层逻辑的 “涅槃重生”？

title_i18n.zh: 新瓶旧酒or涅槃重生？操作系统的 AI 进化终将走向何方？
title_i18n.en: Old wine in a new bottle or rebirth from ashes? Where will the AI evolution of operating systems ultimately lead?
title_i18n.es: ¿Nuevo envase para vino viejo o renacimiento del fénix? ¿Hacia dónde se dirige finalmente la evolución de la IA en los sistemas operativos?

excerpt_i18n.zh: 过去一年，AI 技术已从概念热潮深度渗透至产业肌理，成为驱动 IT 基础设施重构的核心引擎。当大模型、异构算力、智能体（Agent）等技术要素持续冲击传统技术体系，操作系统作为软硬件协同的核心枢纽，其 AI 进化的本质也引发了行业的深刻思考：OS 的 AI 进化，究竟是换汤不换药的 “新瓶旧酒”，还是颠覆底层逻辑的 “涅槃重生”？
excerpt_i18n.en: Over the past year, AI technology has evolved from a conceptual trend to deeply permeate the industrial fabric, becoming a core engine driving the reconstruction of IT infrastructure. As key technological elements like large models, heterogeneous computing power, and intelligent agents continue to challenge traditional systems, the operating system, as the central hub for software-hardware coordination, has prompted profound industry reflection on the nature of its AI evolution: Is the AI advancement of the OS merely a superficial change, or a fundamental transformation that reshapes its underlying logic?
excerpt_i18n.es: En el último año, la tecnología de IA ha pasado de ser una tendencia conceptual a integrarse profundamente en la estructura industrial, convirtiéndose en el motor central que impulsa la reestructuración de la infraestructura de TI. Mientras elementos tecnológicos como los modelos grandes, la computación heterogénea y los agentes inteligentes continúan impactando los sistemas tecnológicos tradicionales, el sistema operativo, como núcleo de coordinación entre hardware y software, ha generado una profunda reflexión en la industria sobre la esencia de su evolución hacia la IA: ¿se trata simplemente de un cambio superficial, como "vino viejo en botella nueva", o de una transformación radical que reinventa la lógica subyacente, similar a un renacimiento?

On February 2, Ant Group's general AI assistant Lingguang announced a comprehensive upgrade to its core feature "Flash Apps," officially launching two new capabilities: "Upload Image to Generate App" and "Desktop Widgets." The upgrade integrates nearly 20 API tools, including audio synthesis, large language model (LLM) calls, calendar services, multimodal understanding, text-to-speech, persistent storage, gyroscope, and vibration feedback. excerpt_i18n.en: As AI transitions from a technological concept into the "deep-water zone" of value realization, how can industry and research collaborate deeply to jointly realize the value loop of industrial AI adoption and technological commercialization? What technical bottlenecks in the development of industrial-scale AI models urgently need to be addressed? How can cutting-edge AI applications penetrate complex industrial chains and truly integrate into industrial decision-making environments? ... On January 30, Wanlian Yida, as a leading enterprise promoting the application and implementation of industrial AI models across industries, held a thematic seminar titled "AI + Industrial Development" with the theme "Breaking Through with Applications, Gathering Strength with Ecology" in Beijing. At the event, the nation's first "Industrial Artificial Intelligence Research and Application Expert Committee" (referred to as the "Expert Committee") was officially inaugurated. Sun Maosong, Executive Vice Dean of the Institute for Artificial Intelligence at Tsinghua University and a Foreign Fellow of the European Academy of Sciences, serves as the chief advisor of the Expert Committee. Leading a team of AI technical advisors, including Professor Liu Ming from Harbin Institute of Technology, Professor Xu Jungang from the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Professor Zhang Lei from Beijing Institute of Technology, and Associate Professor Liu Zhenghao from Northeastern University, they jointly advance the construction, development, and application of the industrial AI model "Wanlian Moore," injecting intellectual support into its next phase of development. Attendees noted that this seminar was not merely a technical showcase but directly addressed the pain points of disconnection between industry and research. Based on the positioning of Wanlian Moore as a comprehensive industrial AI super-carrier, the event analyzed pathways to build the "AI + Data + Scenarios" triad, guiding industrial intelligence into a new cycle. Wanlian Yida has specially established an "Advisor Express Channel." Following the joint issuance of the "Action Plan for 'AI + Manufacturing'" by eight ministries, including the National Development and Reform Commission...
excerpt_i18n.es: Cuando la IA pasa de ser un concepto tecnológico a la "zona profunda" de la materialización de valor, ¿cómo pueden la producción y la investigación colaborar estrechamente para lograr conjuntamente el ciclo cerrado de valor de la transformación industrial mediante IA y la comercialización tecnológica? ¿Qué cuellos de botella técnicos existen en el desarrollo de modelos de IA a nivel industrial que requieren solución urgente? ¿Cómo pueden las aplicaciones de IA de vanguardia penetrar en las complejas cadenas industriales e integrarse verdaderamente en los entornos de toma de decisiones industriales? ... El 30 de enero, Wanlian Yida, como empresa líder en promover la aplicación de modelos de IA a gran escala en toda la industria, celebró en Beijing un seminario temático sobre "IA + desarrollo industrial" con el tema "Romper barreras con aplicaciones, unir fuerzas con el ecosistema". En el evento, se estableció el primer "Comité de Expertos en Investigación y Aplicación de Inteligencia Artificial Industrial" del país (en adelante, "Comité de Expertos").

excerpt_i18n.en: The concept of AI in healthcare has been a buzzword in the industry for nearly a decade, yet three formidable gaps persist between laboratory algorithm models and clinical hospital applications: the conflict between data security and utilization, the mismatch between technical barriers and clinical needs, and communication hurdles in cross-disciplinary collaboration. Many well-resourced hospitals have invested heavily in AI systems, only to see them become mere "window displays," while primary care institutions eager for technological empowerment are held back by insufficient operational capabilities and prohibitively high adaptation costs. Amid widespread industry uncertainty where acclaim fails to translate into practical adoption, Inspur Information has provided a replicable solution in Foshan's Nanhai District through a battle-tested "production-research-application" closed-loop model. On January 22, 2026, at the Foshan Nanhai District "Artificial Intelligence + Healthcare" Ecosystem Co-construction Seminar, the district’s "AI + Healthcare" ecosystem co-construction framework was officially unveiled. Simultaneously, the "AI-Native Smart Healthcare System," jointly developed over two years by Inspur Information, Tianrui Yijian, and Foshan Nanhai District People’s Hospital, debuted as a practical exemplar of "AI + Healthcare." Eschewing conceptual hype, it focuses on real pain points across the entire diagnosis and treatment process. Through a collaborative "production-research-application" mechanism—where hospitals identify needs, enterprises tailor solutions, and platforms provide robust support—AI technology is genuinely embedded in clinical frontline settings and extended to grassroots levels. Framework Launch: An "Integrated Body with Two Wings and Three Driving Forces" Mechanism Born from Practice. Currently, artificial intelligence has become a core pillar in strengthening primary care, consolidating foundations, and ensuring essential services in healthcare.
excerpt_i18n.es: El concepto de la IA médica ha resonado en la industria durante casi una década, pero entre los modelos algorítmicos de laboratorio y la aplicación clínica en hospitales siempre han existido tres brechas difíciles de superar: la contradicción entre la seguridad y el uso de los datos, la desconexión entre el umbral tecnológico y las necesidades clínicas, y las barreras de comunicación en la colaboración interdisciplinaria. Muchos hospitales con recursos han invertido grandes sumas en introducir sistemas de IA, que finalmente terminan como "exhibiciones de escaparate"; las instituciones médicas de base anhelan el empoderamiento tecnológico, pero se detienen ante la insuficiencia de capacidad de mantenimiento y los altos costos de adaptación. En un momento de confusión generalizada en la industria, donde hay "más elogios que resultados", Inspur Information ha ofrecido en Foshan Nanhai una respuesta replicable para romper el estancamiento, mediante un modelo de ciclo cerrado "investigación-producción-aplicación" probado en la práctica.

The event gathered investors, media representatives, channel partners, and end-users from around the world, showcasing Dreame's latest technological achievements and product innovations in the field of intelligent cleaning, further highlighting its technological leadership in the global high-end cleaning appliance market.
